segments.title: Cold Open & Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official broadcast sign-on; Case banters about broken fish tie, Chicago sketch fest trip, and missing Jizbo.

segments.title: NYC Mayoral Race & Venezuela War Pretext
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple discuss Trump endorsing Cuomo over Mamdani, Sliwa's polling, and Rubio/Trump pushing regime change in Venezuela using fentanyl pretext that spills into Colombia/Mexico targets.

segments.title: How To Pitch News, Drink, and Fart Noise
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget hosts from his workshop with his deceased father trapped in a wooden board; covers news pitching, alcohol tolerance, and fart-noise technique while bickering about Jeb's afterlife housing.

segments.title: Crum's Wife, Frederick, and 80s Theme Songs
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate whether Crum knows his wife is with Frederick (aka Freddie Jizbo); devolves into Baywatch and Thunder and Paradise theme-song playback and Crum tongue-piano performance.

segments.title: AI Music Charts, Shifty Brent, and Butt Breathing
segments.notes: Chet commandeers the broadcast to discuss Billboard AI artists (Zanya Monet, Juno Sky), Joe Rogan praising Shifty Brent covers, Japanese butt-breathing oxygen trial, and Meta porn-torrent lawsuit.

segments.title: Cybertrucks, Scott Adams, Heidi Klum
segments.notes: Rapid-fire news: Las Vegas police Cybertruck fleet, Scott Adams begging Trump to intervene with Kaiser for prostate-cancer drug, Heidi Klum's Medusa Halloween costume, and Macy's Parade planning.

segments.title: Park Opinions Mixed with Town Hall Queue
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein intercepts park pedestrians for opinions; opinion sheet glitch merges with town-hall questions, yielding wrestling takes, Napoleon wrestling, JD Vance speculation, and a drive-by song slam.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Agitates Crum over wife and Frederick, plays 80s theme songs, claims Crum knows he's being cheated on, and tallies debate points.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Broadcasts from park bushes, processes opinion submissions mixed with town-hall queue, interviews pedestrians on wrestling, JD Vance, and sandwiches.

characters.name: Hype Train

characters.name: Intern
characters.notes: studio intern. Huffs helium with Pepito and Jeff Ripple, denies being a narc when confronted.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opens with Pepito's sign-on and Case's broken fish tie before diving into the NYC mayoral race where Trump endorses Cuomo over socialist frontrunner Mamdani. Jeff Ripple and Case then dissect a Rubio-led push to use fentanyl as pretext for regime change in Venezuela that inadvertently targets Colombia and Mexico. Jeb Nogget hosts a chaotic How To from his workshop with his board-bound father, covering news pitching, alcohol tolerance, and fart noises. Munch and Crum's debate spirals into Baywatch theme songs and Crum's tongue-piano after Munch alleges Crum's wife is with Frederick/Jizbo. Chet commandeers the desk to dissect AI music charts, Shifty Brent, and a Japanese butt-breathing clinical trial. The news block closes with Vegas police Cybertrucks, Scott Adams begging Trump for cancer-drug scheduling, and Heidi Klum's Medusa costume. Trip Bradstein closes the broadcast from the park where his opinion sheet merges with the town-hall queue, yielding wrestling takes, Napoleon fantasies, and JD Vance speculation before a drive-by song slam and a raid attempt on 'Lip'.
